# Samseva Security Force Pvt. Ltd.

> Licensed private security agency based in Karad, Maharashtra, providing professional guarding, industrial, commercial, residential, event security, bouncers and bodyguard services across Maharashtra since 2022.

Samseva Security Force is a PSARA-licensed security agency headquartered at Banawadi, Karad, Satara district, Maharashtra. The company deploys trained and background-verified security personnel to industries, corporate campuses, banks, colleges, residential complexes and events throughout Maharashtra, and operates 24/7 with fully insured staff.
